New here?

What to expect on Sunday

Not sure what to expect? Here's what a Sunday morning looks like at Prairie Valley.

Worship

We start at 10:45 AM. We sing together, some hymns and some newer songs, and then we open the Bible.

We go verse by verse through whole books of the Bible, so you hear all of it, not just the favorites.

Kids

Kids start the service with us and sing along. After a short children's message, kids through 5th grade head to Children's Church.

Want to keep your kids with you the whole time? That's totally fine.

What to wear

Wear what's comfortable. Some folks dress up, most come casual, and you'll fit right in either way.

There's a light breakfast every Sunday morning, anything from donuts to homemade breakfast items. Come feed your belly and your soul.
A word from Pastor Josh

If you're thinking about visiting, here's what I'd want you to know. You don't have to have it all figured out. You don't have to know the Bible or dress a certain way. We're not here to impress you. We're here to open the Bible together and point to Jesus.

Come see for yourself. We'd love to sit with you.

Josh Slater, Senior Pastor

Bringing kids? Fill out the guest form ahead of time and check-in will be quick when you get here.

Ministries

Find your place

Church isn't just Sunday morning. Here's what goes on through the week.

Sundays · 10:45 AM

Children's Ministry

Kids sing with us and hear a short children's message, then head to Children's Church (through 5th grade) while the sermon goes on.

Wednesdays · 6:00–7:30 PM

Wednesday Night Kids & Student Ministry

Kids and students dig into the Bible, make friends, and have fun. Adults have their own Bible study the same night, so the whole family can come.

Wednesdays · 6:00–7:30 PM

Wednesday Night Adult Bible Study

Adults open the Bible together in a class taught by Pastor Josh, while kids and students meet in their own groups.

Mondays · 6:00 PM

Small Group Bible Studies

A Ladies' Group and a Men's Group meet Monday evenings to study the Bible, pray, and get to know each other.

Regularly

Men's Ministry

Men get together for prayer and for special nights like Forge Night. Bring a friend.

First Sunday of every month

The Lord's Supper

We take the Lord's Supper together as part of worship on the first Sunday of every month.

About us

Who we are

Prairie Valley Church is a church for the entire community in Campbell, Texas. We believe the Bible is God's Word, and the gospel of Jesus is for everyone. So we preach it plainly. Anyone who wants to hear it is welcome here.
